boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten distinct UMD study settings with documented layouts, technology, or reservation guidance.

cards.title: Terrapin Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: McKeldin Library, second floor
cards.notes: Bring a project partner and use the second-floor commons for its group study rooms and technology-oriented work areas.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative McKeldin setting with group rooms and library technology support.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies the Terrapin Learning Commons on McKeldin's second floor as a hub with group study rooms and technology-packed collaborative spaces.
cards.access_notes: Located inside McKeldin Library; consult current library hours and room-reservation guidance before visiting.

cards.title: McKeldin Library Reading Room
cards.subtitle: McKeldin Library
cards.notes: Choose the reading room when hardwood furniture and chandeliers suit a quieter individual work session.
cards.short_summary: A traditional library reading room with a visually distinctive interior.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD describes McKeldin's reading room as a traditional study space with hardwood furniture and chandeliers.
cards.access_notes: Inside McKeldin Library; check current library operating hours before arrival.

cards.title: McKeldin Library Study Pods
cards.subtitle: McKeldin Library, first, sixth, and seventh floors
cards.notes: Use a first-come pod for solo work; each rounded cubicle has an outlet and upholstered panels intended to reduce noise.
cards.short_summary: Individual pods with power and sound-softening upholstered panels.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD reports that McKeldin study pods on the first, sixth, and seventh floors are first-come, first-served and include outlets and upholstered paneling.
cards.source_title: What You Need to Know in Fall 2024: Learning Support and Libraries
cards.access_notes: First-come, first-served; located inside McKeldin Library, so verify current building hours.

cards.title: McKeldin Library Focus Rooms
cards.subtitle: McKeldin Library, first floor
cards.notes: Reserve a soundproof focus room when you need a private setting for a Zoom meeting or other virtual conversation.
cards.short_summary: Two reservable, soundproof rooms for private virtual meetings.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD states that two soundproof focus rooms on McKeldin's first floor can be reserved for private Zoom meetings.
cards.source_title: What You Need to Know in Fall 2024: Learning Support and Libraries
cards.access_notes: Reservation required; located inside McKeldin Library. Check the Libraries' current reservation and building-hour rules.

cards.title: McKeldin Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Terrapin Learning Commons, McKeldin Library
cards.notes: Plan a small work session in a TLC group room, then use the nearby technology desk if your project needs equipment.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group rooms within McKeldin's collaborative learning commons.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD identifies the Terrapin Learning Commons as a second-floor McKeldin space with group study rooms and a technology desk.
cards.access_notes: Group-room availability and reservations are managed by UMD Libraries; check current requirements before planning a session.

cards.entity_name: Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library Main Reading Room
cards.title: MSPAL Main Reading Room
cards.subtitle: Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Set up in the main reading room when you want individual carrels or a library workstation near performing-arts materials.
cards.short_summary: A spacious arts-library reading room with individual carrels and computer workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD says MSPAL's public areas include a spacious main reading room with individual study carrels and computer workstations.
cards.source_title: About Us | Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library
cards.access_notes: Public area of MSPAL in the Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center; verify current library hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library Lounge-Style Study Room
cards.title: MSPAL Lounge-Style Study Room
cards.subtitle: Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Use the lounge-style room for a less formal reading or planning session within the performing arts library.
cards.short_summary: A named lounge-style study room in UMD's performing arts library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD lists a lounge-style study room among the public areas of the Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library.
cards.source_title: About Us | Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library
cards.access_notes: Public area of MSPAL; check current library hours and any room-use guidance before going.

cards.entity_name: Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library Group Study Room
cards.title: MSPAL Group Study Room
cards.subtitle: Clarice Smith Performing Arts Center
cards.notes: Coordinate a group session in MSPAL's dedicated group study room, then confirm current room-use procedures with the library.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated group-work room within the performing arts library.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD lists a group study room among the public areas of the Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library.
cards.source_title: About Us | Michelle Smith Performing Arts Library
cards.access_notes: Confirm availability and current room-use guidance with MSPAL before organizing a group session.

cards.title: Architecture Library
cards.subtitle: School of Architecture, Planning and Preservation, second floor
cards.notes: Work among architecture and planning materials, with scanning, computer workstations, and study rooms available to students.
cards.short_summary: A second-floor subject library with study rooms, scanning, and computer workstations.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD's architecture school states that its second-floor Architecture Library offers 24/7 access to its students, staff, and faculty for studying and provides study rooms, computer workstations, and scanners.
cards.source_title: Research Tools & Resources | School of Architecture, Planning and Preservation
cards.access_notes: The cited 24/7 access is stated for architecture students, staff, and faculty; other users should confirm access with the library.

cards.entity_name: Edward St. John Learning and Teaching Center Huddle Rooms
cards.title: ESJ Huddle Rooms
cards.subtitle: Edward St. John Learning and Teaching Center
cards.notes: Book a small conference room for a team of three or more, and plan around the three-hour reservation limit.
cards.short_summary: Campus huddle rooms for small-group work with defined booking rules.
cards.evidence_claim: UMD states that ESJ Huddle Rooms are available to students, faculty, and staff; reservations require at least three users, may be made two weeks ahead, and last up to three hours.
cards.source_title: Study Spaces & Tools | Student Success Office
cards.access_notes: Reservation requires a campus directory ID and password, with at least three users; reserve up to two weeks in advance for up to three hours.
